plain_english: Ah, this wins — sweet, this festival of worship — since tears give nectar-taste amply.
sanskrit_cite: aho ko 'pi jayaty eṣa svāduḥ pūjāmahotsavaḥ yato 'mṛtarasāsvādam aśrūṇy api dadaty alam

plain_english: All acts with His worship vanguard are successes; devotees made of Him are themselves successes.
sanskrit_cite: vyāpārāḥ siddhidāḥ sarve ye tvatpūjāpuraḥsarāḥ bhaktānāṃ tvanmayāḥ sarve svayaṃ siddhaya eva te

plain_english: In all beings, all states, at once, all-formed — worshipping You unceasing, they are my gods.
sanskrit_cite: sarvadā sarvabhāveṣu yugapat sarvarūpiṇam tvām arcayanty aviśrantaṃ ye mamaite 'dhidevatāḥ

plain_english: Meditation-perfected touch-festival of You — thus famed as worship-rule — be mine always.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānāyasatiraskārasiddhas tvatsparśanotsavaḥ pūjāvidhir iti khyāto bhaktānāṃ sa sadās tu me

plain_english: Equanimity-essence equinox-moment of devotees is always — ever-worshipping with Your being-rasa-nectar.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ samatāsāraviṣuvatsamayaḥ sadā tvadbhāvarasapīyūṣarasennaiṣāṃ sadārcanam

plain_english: Whose beginning and end are not, nor time-order — that deed is Yours, and its doers resort only to You.
sanskrit_cite: yasyānārambhaparyantau na ca kālakramaḥ prabho pūjātmāsau kriyā tasyāḥ kartāras tvajjuṣaḥ param

plain_english: Brahmā and the rest are fortunate, lords — in whose dream, even delusion, stands Your worship-festival.
sanskrit_cite: brahmādīnām apīśāste te ca saubhāgyabhāginaḥ yeṣāṃ svapne 'pi mohe 'pi sthitas tvatpūjanotsavaḥ

plain_english: Chanting, offering, bathing, meditating — and not only: ah, devotees' worshipping You — whenever, whatever, however much.
sanskrit_cite: japatāṃ juhvatāṃ snātāṃ dhyāyatāṃ na ca kevalam bhaktānāṃ bhavadabhyarcāmaho yāvad yadā tadā

plain_english: Tasting Your worship-nectar-joy, enjoying — to Indra and the rest, to Brahmā-chiefs: is anyone equal?
sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāsudhāsvādasambhogasukhinaḥ sadā indrādīnām atha brahmamukhyānām asti kaḥ samaḥ

plain_english: World-shaking, one-cause festival — what is got thereby, only devotees know who get it.
sanskrit_cite: jagatkṣobhaikajanake bhavatpūjāmahotsave yatprāpyaṃ prāpyate kiṃcid bhaktā eva vidanti tat

plain_english: Standing in Your abode, consciousness-formed, with body-speech-mind acts of all 36 principles — I always worship You, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: tvaddhāmni cinmaye sthitvā ṣaṭtriṃśattattvakarmabhiḥ kāyavākcittaceṣṭādyair arcaye tvāṃ sadā vibho

plain_english: Of me, enjoying union with Your worship — may all time pass, even endless: this I pray.
sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāmayāsaṅgasambhogasukhino mama prayātu kālaḥ sakalo 'py ananto 'pīyadarthaye

plain_english: Greedy for Your worship-enjoyment-nectar — may it grow daily for me and fruit always.
sanskrit_cite: bhavatpūjāmṛtarasābhogalampaṭata vibho vivardhatām anudinaṃ sadā ca phalatāṃ mama

plain_english: In Your ocean, nectar-one-rasa-full, worshipping You, great self, may I always sit.
sanskrit_cite: jagadvilayasañjātasudhaikarasanirbhare tvadabdhau tvāṃ mahātmānam arcannāsīya sarvadā

plain_english: Mind offered as sweet in Your rite — knots ever cut simply.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣavāsanāgranthivicchedasaralaṃ sadā mano nivedyate bhaktaiḥ svādu pūjāvidhau tava

plain_english: Having taken stand on objects — these sense-courses of devotees — send them for Your worship-nectar-wine.
sanskrit_cite: adhiṣṭhāyaiva viṣayānimāḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ bhaktānāṃ preṣayanti svatpūjārtham amṛtāsavam

plain_english: Agitated by devotion-heat, self-mastered — what else could liberate but drowning in worship of You?
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ bhaktisaṃvegamahoṣmavivaśātmanām ko 'nyo nirvāṇahetuḥ syāt tvatpūjāmṛtamajjanāt

plain_english: Perpetual foot-worship-nectar-drinking festival — may it be my sole grace-getting cause, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: satataṃ tvatpadābhyarcāsudhāpānamahotsavaḥ tvatprasādaikasamprāptihetur me nātha kalpatām

plain_english: Experiencing, Lord, moment by moment — Your worship-nectar-drinking-madness-joy-great-joy.
sanskrit_cite: anubhūyāsamīśāna pratikarma kṣaṇāt kṣaṇam bhavatpūjāmṛtāpānamadāsvādamahāmudam

plain_english: Seen is the point of devotees' great worship-undertaking: that they taste impossible joy then.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭartha eva bhaktānāṃ bhavatpūjāmahodyamaḥ tadaiva yad asambhāvyaṃ sukham āsvādayanti te

plain_english: Till Your worship-nectar-taste-festival is got, I count no drop of fortune's happiness tasted.
sanskrit_cite: yāvan na labdhas tvatpūjāsudhāsvādamahotsavaḥ tāvan nāsvādito manye lavo 'pi sukhasampadaḥ

plain_english: Without sense-seeking strain, Your abode's abiding is born in devotees — no getting needed, only madness with worship.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānāṃ viṣayanveṣābhāsāyāsād vinaiva sā ayatnasiddhaṃ tvaddhāmasthitiḥ pūjāsu jāyate

plain_english: Nothing ungettable for devotees, nothing hard — they only roam, mad with worship.
sanskrit_cite: na prāpyam asti bhaktanāṃ nāpy eṣām asti durlabham kevalaṃ vicaranty ete bhavatpūjāmadonmadāḥ

plain_english: Ah, the devotees' heart-heavy worship-rule: praised, unmarked by begging.
sanskrit_cite: aho bhaktibharodāracetasāṃ varada tvayi slāghyaḥ pūjāvidhiḥ ko 'pi yo na yācñākalaṃkitaḥ

plain_english: What beauty is not, what joy not, what fortune not, what liberation not — this Mahādeva, since He is worshipped.
sanskrit_cite: kā na śobhā na ko hlādaḥ kā samṛddhir na vāparā ko vā na mokṣaḥ ko 'py eṣa mahādevo yad arcyate

plain_english: Nourished within by welling bright devotion-nectar — may this body be for Thy worship's use, always devoted.
sanskrit_cite: antarullasadacchācchabhaktipīyūṣapoṣitam bhavatpūjopayogāya śarīram idam astu me

plain_english: Dependent on Your foot-worship-enjoyment — may I, O world-Lord, be the one self-willed in movement.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapūjāsambhogaparatantraḥ sadā vibho bhūyāsaṃ jagatām īśa ekaḥ svacchandaceṣṭitaḥ

plain_english: To quench vision-touch-thirst for You — arises the cool, sweet great lake of Your worship.
sanskrit_cite: tvaddhyānadarśanasparśatṛṣi keṣām api prabho jāyate śītalasvādu bhavatpūjāmahāsaraḥ

plain_english: As You alone are the world's worship-enjoyment-vessel — so, Lord, is the devotee a vessel of worship-enjoyment.
sanskrit_cite: yathā tvam eva jagataḥ pūjāsambhogabhājanam tatheśa bhaktimān eva pūjāsambhogabhājanam

plain_english: Victor, Your festival — even the 36 agitated by it — great day.
sanskrit_cite: ko 'py asau jayati svāmin bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśato 'pi tattvānāṃ kṣobho yatrollasaty alam

plain_english: Bow to those whose worship-things are themselves worshipped, by devotion-nectar-water.
sanskrit_cite: namas tebhyo vibho yeṣāṃ bhaktipīyūṣavāriṇā pūjyāny eva bhavanti tvatpūjopakaraṇāny api

plain_english: At worship's start, meditating mantra-placed His selfhood — devotees rest in supreme self, nowhere roaming.
sanskrit_cite: pūjārambhe vibho dhyātvā mantrādheyāṃ tvadātmatām svātmany eva pare bhaktā mānti harṣeṇa na kvacit

plain_english: Kingdoms blooming, world shared out in nectar-wine by festival-goers.
sanskrit_cite: rājyalābhādivotphullaiḥ kaiś cit pūjāmahotsave sudhāsavena sakalā jagatī saṃvibhajyate

plain_english: Whose moment-drink is worship-nectar — are they gods, freed, or whatever people?
sanskrit_cite: pūjāmṛtāpānamayo yeṣāṃ bhogaḥ pratikṣaṇam kiṃ devā uta muktās te kiṃ vā ke 'py eva te janāḥ

plain_english: The world's dignity as worship-gear is theirs — ah, something of devotees, and just lightness!
sanskrit_cite: pūjopakaraṇībhūtaviśvaveśena gauravam aho kim api bhaktānāṃ kim apy eva ca lāghavam

plain_english: From worship-made eye-throw agitation, nectar-rising for devotees — as from the gods' milk-ocean churning.
sanskrit_cite: pūjāmayākṣavikṣepakṣobhādevāmṛtodgamaḥ bhaktānāṃ kṣīrajaladhikṣobhād iva divaukasām

plain_english: Some take worship as the wish-cow; others, inward-turned, milk the nectar-stream.
sanskrit_cite: pūjāṃ ke cana manyante dhenuṃ kāmadughām iva sudhādhārādhikarasāṃ dhayanty antarmukhāḥ pare

plain_english: Even eye-throws, world-approved, bring something within — may the festival grow.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktānām akṣavikṣepo 'py eṣa saṃsārasaṃmataḥ upanīya kim apy antaḥ puṣṇāty arcāmahotsavam

plain_english: By devotion-agitation, worship in self-become-Him — wonder: poverty's top fruit is lowliness' fruit.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktikṣobhavaśād īśa svātmabhūte 'rcanaṃ tvayi citraṃ dainyāya no yāvad dīnatāyāḥ paraṃ phalam

plain_english: For some, rite is upacāra-step to His feet; for devotees, non-duality-bliss-spread.
sanskrit_cite: upacārapadaṃ pūjā keṣāṃ cit tvatpadāptaye bhaktānāṃ bhavadaikātmyanirvṛttiprasaras tu saḥ

plain_english: Spread by unbound mad devotion to the formless-seeming, it gains some foothold in You.
sanskrit_cite: apy asambaddharūpārcābhaktyunmādanirargalaiḥ vitanyamānā labhate pratiṣṭhāṃ tvayi kām api

plain_english: Taste-stunned mind; He alone as worship's vessel, they say.
sanskrit_cite: svādubhaktirasāsvādastabdhībhūtamanaś cyutām śambho tvam eva lalitaḥ pūjānāṃ kila bhājanam

plain_english: Full, pure, steady, devoted means be mine for His worship, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: paripūrṇāni śuddhāni bhaktimanti sthirāṇi ca bhavatpūjāvidhau nātha sādhanāni bhavantu me

plain_english: In the whole worship-treasure, what fortune of the organ-host blooms?
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣapūjāsatkośe tvatpūjākarmaṇi prabho aho karaṇavṛndasya kāpi lakṣmīr vijṛmbhate

plain_english: This prettiness is Yours alone, Lord: though Lord of all, worshipped by servants — and found.
sanskrit_cite: eṣā peśalimā nātha tavaiva kila dṛśyate viśveśvaro 'pi bhṛtyair yad arcyase yaś ca labhyase

plain_english: Rise from formed or formless, being or non-being — may my festival rise.
sanskrit_cite: sadāmurttād amūrttādvā bhāvād yad vāpy abhāvataḥ uttheyān me praśastasya bhavatpūjāmahotsavaḥ

plain_english: With lust, anger, pride made offering, who always worship — bow to them; of them I am pleased, in truth.
sanskrit_cite: kāmakrodhābhimānais tvām upaharīkṛtaiḥ sadā ye 'rcayanti namas tebhyas teṣāṃ tuṣṭo 'smi tattvataḥ

plain_english: Victor, Your festival of devotees' supreme rule — though made with straw, yet furnished with jewels.
sanskrit_cite: jayaty eṣa bhavadbhaktibhājāṃ pūjāvidhiḥ paraḥ yas tṛṇaiḥ kriyamāno 'pi ratnair evopakalpate
